article.title: What’s next for the socialist movement after the resounding defeat of Trump, MAGA, ICE, and the Iran War? [The Socialist Program]

article.content: November 3rd was an electoral bloodbath for the Republican party and the MAGA movement. Brian Becker and Layan Fuleihan discuss.
